holdout.reason: All 30 extraction cases were reused for prompt/model iteration, including the four I2 holdout IDs. No newly authorized, privacy-reviewed independent inputs were available in the supplied artifacts.

steps: Obtain 12 never-tuned public or explicitly authorized sources, 3 per format, from source families absent from development; do not derive crops or paraphrases of I2 sources.
Record access/authorization, remove names/contact/account/address/EXIF and review every page; retain originals privately.
Two humans label fields, source spans and critical facts without consulting predictions; resolve disagreements and known gold issues.
Create source-corpus-i3-v2 with IDs/input/gold hashes and signed split lock before any prompt tuning or evaluation calls. Never edit v1 or promote a development case to holdout.

knownGoldIssues.issue: Frozen gold has tilde; original PDF uses hyphen. Preserve baseline; do not normalize range separators or silently correct gold.
